description: Manual dataset curation for Live2D humanoid part segmentation. Non-humanoid PSDs, instruction sheets, depth maps, and platform sidecar files are excluded before COCO conversion.

selection_policy.include: Humanoid or humanoid-adjacent character PSDs that can improve body, face, hair, clothes, limb, or accessory segmentation.
selection_policy.exclude: Pure non-humanoid illustrations, depth maps, readme/terms sheets, invalid macOS resource files, and files whose visible composite is not a usable character.
